The Arunachal Pradesh, Publlc Service Commission, invite Online applications are from

(a) Before applying online Application for the posts must mandatorily reglster themselves through ONE
TIME REGIST ATION (OTRI in the Commission's website
(b) Applicants are required to apply online using the website www,a ppsc.sov.in. Detail instructions for

Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh from time to time.

examination shall also be eligible to apply. However, such final year candidates must upload a 'Bonafide
certificate' to establish their claim.
